diagnostics.partial_reason: Twelve Python string/bool stages were not admitted, so semantic IR, CinderX HIR/LIR, and machine-code artifacts do not exist. Document dedup is a Daft dataflow operation, not a Python UDF.
diagnostics.deployment_caveat: The remote pipeline image contains an older UDF JIT revision and cannot emit the current full diagnostic bundle. This bundle is an offline qualification artifact; the fixed-source real-pipeline A/B was run separately with diagnostics disabled.

primary_gate.condition: capture is attempted only when the logical schema contains float64

admission_summary.secondary_gate: Daft mapper/filter wrappers close over the operator function, so extending only the schema gate would still leave closure and signature rejections.

forced_probe_results.detail: CaptureVerificationError escapes try_capture instead of becoming a structured rejection.

typed_leaf_results.reason: String input and multi-argument or keyword-only signatures are outside the current bool/int/float scalar ABI.

diagnostic_defects.finding: try_capture catches CaptureRejected but not CaptureVerificationError; the Daft registry's broad exception handler then silently drops verification failures.
diagnostic_defects.required_fix: Normalize verification failures to structured rejection artifacts before adding string support.

diagnostic_defects.finding: Candidates rejected by schema admission do not naturally emit a complete source-to-rejection bundle.
diagnostic_defects.required_fix: Emit source identity, original bytecode, rejection reason, and downstream unavailable_reason at the driver gate under diagnostics=full.

model_coverage.diagnostic_function_basis: Stand-in functions matching the historical VOLC_REAL_TEXT_OPS=0 UDF JIT experiment, plus static signature probes for official model-backed functions.
model_coverage.real_ab_runtime: Official fastText and SentencePiece/KenLM paths were enabled.
model_coverage.conclusion_scope: The no-hit conclusion applies to both paths because the schema and callable signatures remain string/bool, but current source-to-machine artifacts for the real model-backed runtime are not available.
